verdict.rationale: Vue's own site lists Pinia under "Official Libraries" next to Vue Router, so it presents Pinia as a first-party state management library. Community reports independently confirm Vue has long shipped an official store (Vuex) alongside its official router. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of Pinia's capabilities, explicit evidence of how Pinia is maintained alongside core releases, and hands-on corroboration specific to Pinia rather than the older Vuex.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an official first-party state management library maintained alongside the framework

citations.quote: Official Libraries: Vue Router, Pinia, Tooling Guide
Vue has an official router and store (Vuex)
